notes: H2O America is the renamed SJW Group.

industry_position.detail: Investor-owned network of local water and wastewater utilities in California, Connecticut, Maine and Texas.

commodity_exposure.detail: Treated drinking water and wastewater service to many service connections.

revenue_structure.detail: Rates set by state utility commissions, e.g. Maine commission approved unified rate.

energy_transition.detail: Water utility; no fossil or renewable energy production.
